remarks: New to Market and updated for today's lifestyle! Experience the pinnacle of New England charm at this luxurious 1830's Wilton, Connecticut home, seamlessly blending historical allure with modern sophistication. Roughly an hour's drive from New York City, this meticulously restored residence offers approximately 3,400 square feet of refined living space. This immaculately maintained 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath home, constructed of stone and wood, exudes timeless charm and durability. The original wooden beams traverse the ceiling, a testament to the home's heritage, while the modern touches ensure comfort at every turn. Nestled on a stunning 3-acre lot, it offers ample space and privacy. The home features a magnificent dining room with three double French doors leading out to an expansive patio, ideal for family entertainment. The living room, with its large summer beams, offers a cozy yet elegant atmosphere. Three fireplaces provide warmth and ambiance, setting the stage for serene evenings. Enjoy wide-plank floors and other period details, along with an abundance of windows that fill the house with natural light. Located in a highly desirable location, it is convenient to shopping and both Wilton and Ridgefield towns, Wilton's top-rated schools, and trains and highways. Set on three acres, the property invites you to immerse yourself in the natural beauty of its surroundings. This charming antique appeals to more than just antique lovers-it's a must-see! Don't miss this!
